name: Flanger vs chorus vs phaser: portable delay+LFO params
goal: Choose and dial modulation FX from first principles: flanger (<~15 ms delayed copy → harmonic comb + LFO on delay + feedback), chorus (~20–50 ms delayed copy + LFO pitch-beating, often multi-voice/stereo LFO), phaser (all-pass stages → fewer non-harmonic notches + LFO on frequency); use static (LFO amount 0), slow motion, or audio-rate as texture—best on harmonically rich sources.

source.title: How FLANGER, CHORUS & PHASER process your sound - Sound Design Theory

prerequisites: Flanger, chorus, and/or phaser modules with delay/rate/depth/feedback (or poles/stages)

outputs.name: mod_fx_settings
outputs.description: Configured flanger/chorus/phaser with intentional LFO use

steps.action: Flanger: duplicate signal; delay wet copy typically below ~15 ms; mix creates harmonic-series comb peaks/nulls. Set delay + feedback for comb position/strength; rate + depth LFO the delay for the classic sweep. Optional feedback polarity for different comb character.
steps.expect: Harmonic comb sweep or static comb texture

steps.action: Chorus: same duplicate idea but longer delay (~20–50 ms). LFO on delay also pitch-modulates the wet (vibrato-like beating with dry). Often no feedback; may use multiple delayed voices. Stereo chorus = different L/R delays and LFO rates.
steps.expect: Thickness / multi-source illusion without flanger harshness

steps.action: Phaser: wet path through one or more all-pass filters (phase shift by frequency, not uniform delay). Mix with dry → fewer notches, not necessarily harmonic. Frequency + feedback move/strengthen notches; rate/depth LFO frequency; poles/stages = more notches (harsher).
LFO strategies: amount 0 for static comb/texture; normal/slow rate for motion; very fast rate past hearing individual cycles → distortion-like FM texture.
steps.expect: Static, musical motion, or audio-rate grit as chosen

steps.action: Prefer these on rich-harmonic sources (FM, distorted, bright pads)—comb/notch motion is more audible. Use as insert texture or send-colored motion before reverb on cinematic pads.
steps.expect: Effect clearly audible on harmonic-rich material

verification: Correct delay-time regime: flanger <~15 ms vs chorus ~20–50 ms
Phaser uses all-pass stages/poles, not a uniform short delay comb
LFO amount matches static vs motion vs audio-rate intent
constraints: Ground every step in the source YouTube-provided Show-transcript text; do not invent UI paths or numeric settings not stated there.

Original synthesis / signal-flow only — map brand UI (Ableton/Vital/Serum/VAST/etc.) to portable osc/filter/env/LFO/FX modules for Traveler-inspired or Web Audio hybrid; never rip presets, wavetables, or samples.
Prefer transferable parameter relationships over vendor-specific preset or bank names.
